name: PCB Assembly Guide
description: Step-by-step hand-assembly guide for your board, as one web page with a 3D view.
description_full:
Adds a toolbar button to the PCB editor that writes a hand-assembly guide for the open board as a single HTML file.

The page shows the board in 3D with KiCad's own models and walks through it one part at a time: the next part is ringed, with its value and package in large type, a red dot at the cathode, positive pad or pin 1, and a note on how to find that mark on the part. It opens on a kit list with the quantity of every value.

The file works offline in any browser on a PC, tablet or phone, so it can be sent to whoever is building the board. Nothing else needs to be installed; the 3D view needs KiCad 8 or later.
